description: Spec explicitly documents the product downgrade: 'AR' in this iteration = WebXR on supported devices + interactive 3-D viewer fallback, not Unity AR Foundation. Rationale and future-task ('AR-furniture-placement-unity-v2') are named in spec §5 D-1.
Spec picks per-category default GLB models (four files: desk/bed/chair/lighting) and documents upgrade path to furniture.model_url column.
Spec picks try-and-fallback capability detection (Option B): always navigate; scene posts AR_NOT_SUPPORTED on canActivateAR=false.
Spec picks floating '배치 완료' button inside HTML overlay with '취소' secondary; post-commit Alert offers '위시리스트에 추가' / '닫기'.
Spec picks RN-layer tests only (Option C), mocking the WebView. Zero Unity test infra required.
Spec pins platform targets: iOS 13+ and Android 7+ with Chrome 79+. Below-threshold devices fall through to fallback panel.
RecommendationScreen.tsx contains a new Pressable per ItemCard with testID 'btn-ar-{furnitureId}' and label 'AR로 배치'. Existing 'btn-wishlist-{furnitureId}' Pressable remains.
App.tsx RootStackParamList contains 'ARPlacement: { roomId: string; item: RecommendationItem }' and registers the Stack.Screen at the end of the navigator.
src/mobile/src/ar/bridge.ts exports AR_BRIDGE_VERSION=1, InboundARMessage, OutboundARMessage, OutboundARErrorCode, encodeInbound, decodeOutbound.
placement.html contains a <model-viewer> element with the 'ar' attribute and the three ar-modes keywords 'webxr', 'scene-viewer', 'quick-look'.
placement.html contains the two Korean overlay buttons: '배치 완료' (btn-place) and '취소' (btn-cancel).
placement.html pins the model-viewer CDN URL to version 3.5.0: 'https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/model-viewer/3.5.0/model-viewer.min.js'.
All four placeholder GLB files exist: desk.glb, bed.glb, chair.glb, lighting.glb under src/mobile/assets/ar/models/.
Each of the four GLB files is > 0 bytes (placeholder valid-header permissible; zero-byte file fails).
placement.html contains viewport meta tag with 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover'.
placement.html uses 'window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage' verbatim for outbound messages.
ARPlacementScreen.tsx exists at src/mobile/src/screens/ARPlacementScreen.tsx and default-exports a React component.
App.tsx <Stack.Screen> order is Home, Upload, Analyzing, StyleSelection, Recommendation, Wishlist, ARPlacement — ARPlacement appended at the end; no reorder of the first six.
bridge.test.ts covers encodeInbound (load + unload), decodeOutbound (placed + cancelled + all 4 error codes), and rejects wrong bridgeVersion, missing fields, unknown event names.

ARPlacementScreen.tsx contains the four per-type dimension tuples verbatim: desk {1.20,0.60,0.74}, bed {1.60,2.00,0.45}, chair {0.55,0.55,0.90}, lighting {0.30,0.30,1.50}; colorHex in inbound load is null.
Mounting ARPlacementScreen renders an element with testID 'ar-webview'.
Emitting {event:'placed',pose:{x,y,z,yaw}} from the mocked WebView triggers Alert.alert with title '배치 완료' and message '위시리스트에 추가하시겠습니까?'.
target_file_or_test: src/mobile/__tests__/ARPlacementScreen.test.tsx:placed triggers Alert with title and message

description: The Alert shown on 'placed' contains exactly two buttons with labels '위시리스트에 추가' and '닫기'.
target_file_or_test: src/mobile/__tests__/ARPlacementScreen.test.tsx:placed Alert buttons are 위시리스트에 추가 and 닫기

description: Tapping '위시리스트에 추가' in the Alert calls addToWishlist with {furnitureId, category: item.type, price: item.price} sourced from the route param's item.
Emitting {event:'cancelled'} calls navigation.goBack and does NOT call addToWishlist or show any Alert.
For each OutboundARErrorCode (AR_NOT_SUPPORTED, AR_CAMERA_DENIED, AR_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, AR_SESSION_ERROR), emitting the error renders the matching Korean copy from AR_ERROR_COPY. Four sub-assertions.
On any error event the 'ar-webview' testID is removed from the rendered tree; 'ar-fallback' testID is present.
After dismissing the placed-confirmation Alert (via either button), the ARPlacementScreen is unmounted (navigation side-effect fires).
After unmount of ARPlacementScreen under fake timers, jest.getTimerCount() === 0 and no lingering listener references on the webviewRef.
emitArFurniturePlaced is invoked exactly once per 'placed' event with (roomId, furnitureId, pose).

On wishlist-add success / already-exists / already-purchased / network-error / api-error branches, the toast / alert copy matches RecommendationScreen's byte-for-byte: '위시리스트에 담았어요.', '이미 위시리스트에 있어요.', '이미 구매 완료로 표시된 항목이에요.', '네트워크 오류로 추가하지 못했어요.', '위시리스트에 추가하지 못했어요.'.
Tapping 'btn-ar-back' on the fallback panel calls navigation.goBack.
src/mobile/package.json dependencies contains 'react-native-webview' pinned to a 13.x version.
RecommendationScreen.test.tsx asserts btn-ar-{furnitureId} testID is present for every rendered card in a multi-category fixture.
Tapping btn-ar-{furnitureId} calls navigation.navigate('ARPlacement', {roomId, item}) with the card's own item and the screen's roomId.

Existing RecommendationScreen AC-48 (analytics emit on wishlist add) and UC-02 AC-49 (addToWishlist call on tap) regressions remain green. Neither assertion is renamed, deleted, or re-scoped by this task.
Git diff under src/backend, src/ai, src/mobile/src/api between the task branch and the base is empty (no files added, modified, or deleted).

artifacts/AR-furniture-placement/api_contract.yaml exists and parses as valid YAML. It documents the bridge inbound/outbound message schemas (NOT an OpenAPI 3.x document — a comment at the top declares so).
Both the 'AR로 배치' button on RecommendationScreen and the '돌아가기' button on the fallback panel expose accessibilityLabel and accessibilityRole='button'.
App.tsx contains exactly seven <Stack.Screen name="..."> declarations in this order: Home, Upload, Analyzing, StyleSelection, Recommendation, Wishlist, ARPlacement.

Full mobile jest suite (UploadScreen, AnalyzingScreen, StyleSelectionScreen, RecommendationScreen, WishlistScreen, HomeScreen, pollSchedule, styleTypes, errorMessages, bridge, ARPlacementScreen) exits 0.
placement.html does not contain any of: 'google-analytics', 'gtag', 'facebook.com', 'amplitude', 'mixpanel'. Only the pinned model-viewer CDN URL is external.
decodeOutbound throws when bridgeVersion != 1; throws when event is not one of placed|cancelled|error; throws when event='placed' lacks pose; throws when event='error' lacks errorCode.
placement.html installs a global hook named window.__authenticSelfBridgeLoad that RN's injectJavaScript invokes to deliver the inbound load message.
No Unity project directory (src/unity/, Assets/, ProjectSettings/) is created; no C# files are added to the repo.
No Flyway migration file is added or modified; V1..V7 under src/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/ are byte-identical to the base branch.
